page.overview:
Who is Calamity Ganon?

One hundred years prior to the events of , a prophecy warned of the return of Ganon. Hoping to prepare in the same fashion as their ancestors, the Hyrulians began working to locate and excavate the Divine Beasts and Guardians. Four from each of Hyrule's races were chosen to pilot the Divine Beast of their people and the restoration of the mechanical army seemed to be a phenomenal success. Meanwhile, Princess Zelda worked to awaken her sealing powers alongside a young knight, Link, who had been appointed as her protector. Zelda was determined to awaken her power and prayed at the three springs of the goddess Hylia in Hyrule, but her efforts were met with failure. Minutes after she had finished praying at the Spring of Wisdom, Ganon broke the seal that kept him dormant in and rose up around it.

In a move unanticipated by the Royal Family of Hyrule, Calamity Ganon managed to corrupt the entire army with his Malice and turned them against the Hyrulians. With its strongest weapons turned against it, Hyrule was laid to ruin and grievously wounded, requiring him to sleep in the Shrine of Resurrection for 100 years. Zelda went to confront the monster on her own and managed to seal it once more, though this required her to also become its prisoner to maintain the seal.

Throughout the Hero of the Wild's journey during the events of , Ganon as his Malice spirit form can be seen swarming around Hyrule Castle, When arrives at the Sanctum of Hyrule Castle, Ganon is found hibernating within a cocoon, attempting to regenerate a physical form. Link awakes Ganon from this process prematurely, confronting him in an incomplete form resembling a grotesque mixture of his human alter ego Ganondorf, , and parts, therefore appearing like a massive scorpion with spider-like legs and a disproportionate head. Calamity Ganon fights with a mixture of attacks used by his four incarnations of , as well as a quick-charging Guardian laser and several ancient implements resembling mandibles. When defeated, he fights Link again in another incomplete form resembling a gigantic boar known as Dark Beast Ganon.

If Link manages to acquire all four of the Divine Beasts, at the start of the final battle, Calamity Ganon will be fired at by them, reducing his health bar down to half. (1/8 of his health per Divine Beast freed)
